week34.0: Ingane, ngenxa yokuntuleka kwesikhala, ngokuvamile igcina imilenze yayo igobile iye esifubeni ngenkathi iqhubeka nokunyakaza njalo.
week34.3: Naphezu kwesikhala esincishisiwe, ukunyakaza kwengane nokushintsha kwesimo sesisu sakho ngokuvamile kuhlala kubonakala.
week34.4: Ukuqhubeka nokunaka ukunyakaza okujwayelekile kwengane kuhlala kubalulekile kuze kube yilapho izalwa.

week35.0: Ingane iqhubeka nokugcwala, okuzoyisiza ilawule izinga layo lokushisa lapho isizelwe. Isikhala esikhona esibelethweni siya sincipha.
week35.3: Ingcindezi ye-pelvis ekhulu kakhulu ingavela njengoba ingane yehla kancane kancane.
week35.4: Naphezu kwesikhala esincane, ingane kufanele iqhubeke nokunyakaza ngokuvamile okufana namasonto adlule.

week36.0: Amaphaphu ngokuvamile asekhulile ngokwanele ukuvumela ukuphefumula ngokuzimele, futhi ingane iyakwazi ukumunca nokugaya.
week36.3: Ungase ngezinye izikhathi uzizwe uphelelwa umoya kakhulu, njengoba isibeletho sithatha isikhala esiningi ngaphansi kwezimbambo.
week36.4: Ukukhulelwa kubhekwa njengokuphelele phakathi kweviki lama-37 neleshumi nane nambili.

week37.0: Ingane ibhekwa njengesikhulile ngokwanele ukuzalwa. Iningi elikhulu lezingane manje likhundleni sekhanda phansi.
week37.3: Umuzwa wengcindezi ekhulayo ye-pelvis uyajwayeleka njengoba ingane ingena ku-pelvis.
week37.4: Kusukela kuleli sonto, usuku lokubeletha lubhekwa njengolufinyelelwe futhi ukuzalwa kungenzeka noma yinini.

week38.0: Izinwele ezincane ezazimboza isikhumba sezinyamalele kakhulu, futhi amathumbu aqoqa i-meconium, indle yokuqala yengane esanda kuzalwa.
week38.3: Ukujwayela izimpawu zokubeletha kungaba usizo njengoba ukuzalwa kusondela.
week38.4: Ukuzalwa okuhlelelwe, uma kuthathwa ngaphandle kwesizathu sezokwelapha, ngokuvamile akunconywa ngaphambi kweviki lama-39.

week39.0: Isikhumba, esasincane ngaphambili, siqinile futhi manje sivikela ingane kangcono. Ungqimba lokuvikela, i-vernix, nalo lwenza kube lula ukudlula ngesikhathi sokuzalwa.
week39.3: Ukungabi nesineke nokukhathala okuthile kuyajwayeleka njengoba usuku lokubeletha lusondela.
week39.4: Ukuhamba kwegazi kwengane esanda kuzalwa kuyaqhubeka nokuzilungisa ngokushesha ngemva kokuzalwa, okungenza izandla noma izinyawo zibe nombala obhulukhwini kancane okwesikhashana.

week40.0: Ingane isikhulile ngokuphelele futhi isilungele ukuzalwa. Usuku lokubeletha lungumbono olinganisiwe: ukuzalwa okuningi kwenzeka ezinsukwini ezizungezile, ngaphambi noma ngemva.
week40.3: Ukulinda izimpawu zokubeletha (ukucindezela okujwayelekile, ukuphuka kwamanzi) kuyajwayeleka phakathi nalesi sikhathi.
week40.4: Ukudlula kancane usuku lokubeletha kuhlala kujwayelekile futhi akusho ngempela ukuthi kunenkinga; ukuqashelwa ngokucophelela kakhulu ngokuvamile kuyanikezwa.

week41.0: Ingane isahlala isikhulile ngokuphelele. Ngemva kosuku lokubeletha, ukuqashelwa ngokucophelela kakhulu ngokuvamile kuyanikezwa ukuhlola impilo yengane.
week41.1: Ukulinda isikhathi eside kungase kuhambisane nokukhathala nokungabi nesineke okwandayo.
week41.2: Ukudlula usuku lokubeletha ngokuvamile kuholela ekuqashelweni okwandayo yithimba lezokwelapha.
